expectations: Explains that zero request volume causes `rate(...) / rate(...)` to return `NaN`, which Argo Rollouts records as `Inconclusive`
Provides the `NaN`-safe `successCondition` `isNaN(result[0]) || result[0] < 0.05` (and/or PromQL `or vector(0)` guard)
